name: Loyal Lithium Limited
summary: Loyal Lithium Limited, formerly Monger Gold Ltd., is a lithium-focused company working on battery minerals and related technology. Its assets include the Brisk and Trieste lithium projects in Quebec's James Bay Lithium District and the Scotty Lithium Project in Nevada, United States. Established in 2020, it is headquartered in Peppermint Grove, Australia.
